deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme analyses requests twice a year, in July and February.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

also.quote: The Academic Commission will analyze the requests at least twice every academic year (July and February)

supervisor.value: The Academic Commission admits candidates first and assigns a supervisor afterwards.
supervisor.quote: The Commission will assign a supervisor (tutor) to each admitted student

funding.value: UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls; the programme pages do not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: Holders of a 300-ECTS Spanish bachelor's degree may apply (with bridging courses), as may those with a bachelor's plus master's.
entry_route.quote: b) Individuals holding an official Bachelor degree from Spain consisting of at least 300 ECTS credits

also.quote: According to the Royal Decree 99/2011, to be eligible for a doctoral degree studies a candidate must hold an official Spanish bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a master's degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme pages.

english_waiver.value: The programme requires English at B1 level; no waiver or certificate rule for Indian or English-medium degrees is stated.

notes: Applications go through the electronic admission request with academic records, CV, specialisation and research group. Pre-enrolment is handled through the UPC system.
name: PhD in Computing
